pr_title: Fix mod icons potentially showing incorrectly at daily challenge intro
pr_body:
Prefer using the beatmap's rulesets over the current user selection.

Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/29559.

issue_context.title: When Daily Challenge has a forced mod that is only on a certain ruleset, the game will display a "unknown" mod

review_comments:
Have you actually tested this in practice? I'm not sure that the API is even giving us a `ShortName`. Following the logic:

`PlaylistItem.apiBeatmap`, used for deserialisation, is of type `APIBeatmap`:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/321e509f11416071588a531dc8021667f7fff834/osu.Game/Online/Rooms/PlaylistItem.cs#L46-L56

`APIBeatmap.Ruleset` only sets the `OnlineID`:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/321e509f11416071588a531dc8021667f7fff834/osu.Game/Online/API/Requests/Responses/APIBeatmap.cs#L122

Ah, there was one missing piece to the puzzle...

`APIRuleset.ShortName`:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/321e509f11416071588a531dc8021667f7fff834/osu.Game/Online/API/Requests/Responses/APIBeatmap.cs#L137-L155
